# TVM FFI comparison — 2026-09-25, repeat 3 of 3

[Aggregate and repeat 1](2026-09-25_00087e3_1.md).

**Environment:** benchmark source `00087e3` (the later `fb2189f` only
committed results); Intel Xeon Platinum 8480C, CPU 0 affinity; AMD Instinct
MI308X (gfx942), GPU 0; CPython 3.12.3, Torch 2.14.0+rocm7.2, Triton 3.8.0,
apache-tvm-ffi 0.1.14.post2.dev1+g424558557.d20260924, ROCm 7.2.1.
`TRITON_HOME` and `TVM_FFI_CACHE_DIR` were unset, so their default
caches were reused. The same raw GPU stream was used for both libraries. Compilation, TensorView
conversion, warmup, and argument tuple construction occurred outside the
timer. This measures host calls and enqueue, not GPU completion; FFI no-ops
perform no GPU launch, and the libraries use different GPU binaries.

**Commands:** run these in separate processes from the repository root:

```sh
PYTHONPATH=$PWD taskset -c 0 /tmp/gb2/bin/python benchmarks/bench_ffi_compare.py --iters 1000 --batches 9
PYTHONPATH=$PWD taskset -c 0 /tmp/gb2/bin/python benchmarks/bench_ffi_compare.py --sweep --iters 1000 --batches 9
```
